title: Heartrobber
description: A resource + data pack for Minecraft 1.21.5, introducing the all-familiar heart-drop-upon-death mechanic, as well as various new vanilla-adjacent items and blocks
body:
# HEARTROBBER

## Main Feature list

- Drop-upon-death Hearts ![A minecraft texture of a red heart rotated diagonally with 3 sparkles around it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70aac2ee73bf9f1548ce9caab35b4cffdfe0b2e1.png)
- Steel; Alloying in the Smithing Table ![A minecraft texture of a steel ingot, in a blueish grey colour, cuboidal in shape](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/802e5f850d4530cd3b7bbceba6358bf4552d2e6f.png)![A minecraft texture of an Alloyment Upgrade - a flat coal-coloured card with a steel imprint in the shape of an upwards-pointing arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7a8d1af5a266e6cc41558ef43b4016a10a352dc.png)
- Invisible Item Frames & Frame Locking ![A minecraft texture of a glass item frame, akin to the normal one, except transparent with a light blue glass frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0de7ce438be4f66f17c6b22f323b09e8a37169e4.png)![A minecraft texture of a padlock made out of steel, with a coal-coloured shackle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69e9d32e199101ece40285e27a461239ab0f0502.png)
- Signed cards (can be used as banknotes) ![A minecraft texture of a tag and inscriber - a standard minecraft name tag texture with an amethyst crystal bound by a copper handle floating over it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/faa59e2d7963d0346f505ab6d65e34ac8c6dcf2f.png) ![A minecraft texture of an inscribed amethyst card, somewhat reflective and with two distinctive dark stripes representing text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d81e2a9946ccfe35639a97c519e13838bd5201f.png)
- Ender Chest mail ![A minecraft texture of a closed paper snail mail envelope](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2da882c45fb2e8f28a007e1151ded3c22717e5c.png)
- Craftable small, baseless and armed armour stands ![A minecraft texture of an armor stand, slightly shorter than the usual one and lacking a smooth stone base](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20a2ba4d32789317bc73dc14e532704008445405.png)
- Experience storage (extraction works faster with [Clumps](https://modrinth.com/mod/clumps)!) ![A minecraft texture of a Wise Reinforcement - flat coal-coloured card with an experience-coloured salad green palette imprint in the shape of an upwards-pointing arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d64db95f575538ea74ab01056d11604da9bbf1.png)
- Survival recipes for Structure Void and Light, intended for building ![The standard minecraft texture for Structure Void](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62b9fcc5e95edf803d90bcc264098a351297a656.png)
- Teleportation to Lodestones in the End ![A minecraft texture of the side of an End Relay - with palettes of obsidian and purpur, a dark indicator in the centre within a cross sign of purpur, and two anchor-like purpur attachments on either side of the base](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d6725af331c4214b6b807ab4db9ec6fe702c8a3_0.webp)
- In-game time information in the Action Bar while holding a Clock ![A standard minecraft clock texture, rapidly transitioning from night to day and back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c87d13403e40edd2e6ce9e22ff1d8b700477a8a7.gif)

and supplements to the advancement system with an additional pack-specific tree to guide you through all of this, and more! ![A minecraft texture of a steel nugget, in a blueish grey colour, small and irregular in shape](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9502ea817387963b5582a0bbb63a05a53db0f573.png)

Also, this pack includes **custom sounds with subtitles support**, and currently contains localizations for **English (US+UK)**, **Russian** and **Ukrainian**. All crafting recipes are unlockable naturally.

## Installation notes

To use this pack, you need to add it both as a resource pack and as a data pack. 

On a server, this means you have to add it to `<world>/datapacks/` and link `https://github.com/svntythsnd/heartrobber/releases/latest/download/raw.zip` or `https://github.com/svntythsnd/heartrobber/releases/download/<version>-main/raw.zip` as your `server-resource-pack` in `server.properties`.

If you are using this on a Singleplayer world, simply add the zip file to both your `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` directory and the world's `datapacks/` directory.

## Configurable properties in data storage `heartrobber:config`

- `letterCooldown` - determines after how many in-game days letters are returned back to the sender or removed if the sender is not online
